s: Considering that the rock men at the university hospital showed a hostile attitude towards the Higashikata family, it can be assumed that the reason Poor Tom was purged was because he was branded as a traitor who tried to help Jobin of the hostile faction, the Higashikata family. It seems that he betrayed him before his Stand Ozone Baby because it is an indiscriminate AoE attack Stand and can ignore Wonder of U. The official coloring of the outfit is apricot, so it looks like the body is painted over the top like clothes. [1] Released at JOJO Magazine 2023 WINTER.[2] In the first place, the bubble was wrapped in layers and blown away to prevent Poor Tom from seeing the inside, and it was a high-level bluff to make the stand release by making the illusion that there was a yew seed inside.[3] The real new Locacaca was dug out by Jobin and transplanted into a pot.
